items: Source control shows every change vs the PR base (committed and local), with per-file C/S/M/U chips and live refresh when HEAD rewrites without an ahead-count change
Roadmap, Backlog, Work Graph, and Runs share one dense sortable inventory table with selection detail, delivery badges, and fresh lineage backlinks
Runs detail keeps the live review summary, clears stale worker progress when you switch runs, and labels a paused review launch honestly instead of implying a reviewer is running
Fleet machine Setup shows per-runner seats (identity and quota) without timing out on remote nodes, and model pickers stay scoped per runner (Codex GPT-5.6, Cursor Grok, Grok 4.5)
Independent review language is consistent across gates and timelines; PR cards treat path-skipped CI as unknown rather than forever-pending
